entries.dd0980f7eb6504b1: This business mainly structures and sells small-unit products based on real estate trust beneficial interests. Under this scheme, real estate acquired by a special purpose company is placed in trust and investors acquire trust beneficial interests; the company group earns fees for structuring, handling private placements and trust-related services. It also engages in real estate brokerage and other businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥518 million.

entries.e9406aa8144c9083: This business is called Japanese-style operating lease (JOL). The operator of a tokumei kumiai (anonymous partnership) set up for each project acquires leased assets such as aircraft and leases them to lessees, while consolidated subsidiary JP Lease Products & Services Co., Ltd. structures, sells, manages, handles exit management and carries out administrative work, earning fees. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥32,974 million.

entries.efbc3249081f2a1b: This business is mainly related to solar power generation. The operator of a tokumei kumiai acquires solar power generation equipment and sells the electricity to electric power companies, the company carries out project development and asset management, and JP Lease Products & Services Co., Ltd. handles private placement and administrative work, earning fees and electricity sales revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,256 million.
